entities.summary: Karposh Uprising, a transformative movement in North Macedonia (1600–1800). Emerged from Early Ottoman Conquest & Administration. Catalyzed Karposh Uprising against Ottoman rule and Ottoman authorities abolish the Ohrid Archbishopric.
